answers.core: i think that initialization order would be a useful tool at least for advanced users, and help smooth the experience of using `class_name` in cases like these
answers.workaround: this would be a change to the way the engine loads user classes in a systematic way - barring incidental changes to initialization order due to leveraging engine knowledge no other way exists to my knowledge(eg using preloaded consts to force a dependency and therefore load the class)

title: Add a way to manually determine class initialization order in engine
